title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 17: the fall of Samaria under Hoshea, why Israel was carried away, and the nations settled in the cities of Samaria.

questions.text: How long did Hoshea the son of Elah reign over Israel in Samaria?
questions.explanation: Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.

questions.text: To which king had Hoshea sent messengers, which the king of Assyria saw as conspiracy?
questions.explanation: Hoshea had sent messengers to So king of Egypt and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria.

questions.text: How long did the king of Assyria besiege Samaria?
questions.explanation: The king of Assyria went up to Samaria and besieged it three years.

questions.text: Where did the king of Assyria place the Israelites he carried away?
questions.explanation: He placed them in Halah, on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

answers.text: In Halah, on the Habor, and in the cities of the Medes
In Babylon, Cuthah, Avva and Sepharvaim
In Damascus and in the land of Kir
In Egypt along the banks of the river

questions.text: What molten images did the children of Israel make for themselves?
questions.explanation: They abandoned Yahweh's commandments and made molten images for themselves, even two calves.

questions.text: When Yahweh removed Israel out of his sight, who was left?
questions.explanation: Yahweh removed them out of his sight; there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

questions.text: Whom did Israel make king when Yahweh tore Israel from David's house?
questions.explanation: He tore Israel from David's house, and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king.

answers.text: Omri the captain of the army

questions.text: What did Yahweh send among the new settlers of Samaria because they didn't fear him?
questions.explanation: The king of Assyria placed men in the cities of Samaria; at the beginning of their dwelling there they didn't fear Yahweh, so Yahweh sent lions among them, which killed some of them.

questions.text: Where did one of the priests carried away from Samaria come to live and teach the people how to fear Yahweh?
questions.explanation: One of the priests they had carried away came and lived in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear Yahweh.

questions.text: Which god did the men of Cuth make?
questions.explanation: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal.
